main.description: A directory in the personal cloud. Contains an ordered list of AT-URIs referencing documents or other directories. The root directory is a singleton at rkey 'self'. Directory name is encrypted in encryptedMetadata.

opakeVersion.description: Schema version for the app.opake.* namespace.

keyWrapping.description: How to unwrap the content key that protects encryptedMetadata. Directories have no blob, so only key material is needed — no cipher algorithm or nonce.

entries.description: Ordered list of AT-URIs of child documents or directories.
